trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team), (p)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t), (o)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (c)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) <= 2005 OR p.position = 'Backcourt' OR CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 41 WITH DISTINCT t.team_name AS team_name, c.city_name AS city_name, CAST(c.area AS DOUBLE) * 2.58999 AS area_km2 RETURN team_name AS col1, SUM(area_km2) AS col2
